title: First Contact
intro: Three questions. Three choices each. Take your time, then stay for the explanation.

questions.prompt: Which is Earth's largest ocean basin?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is Earth's largest ocean basin. It is also the deepest; the Atlantic is the second largest.

source.title: NOAA: What is the largest ocean basin on Earth?

questions.prompt: Which planet takes longer to rotate once than to orbit the Sun?
questions.explanation: Venus rotates once in about 243 Earth days and orbits in about 225. That is a rotation period; its sunrise-to-sunrise cycle is shorter.

source.title: NASA Space Place: All About Venus

questions.prompt: How many hearts does a red octopus have?
questions.explanation: A red octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood through the gills, while the other pumps it through the body.
